item.title: Pokémon Go 'Twilight Wishes' event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go ’s "Twilight Wishes" event is here to wrap up the "Twilight Trails" season. Running from Nov. 24-30 , this event brings back the Pokémon featured in the previous events throughout the season, and marks the return of Espeon and Umbreon in their themed scarfs, as well as Pikachu in their sun and moon crowns.

item.title: New Xbox Was Originally Planned to Ditch Paid Multiplayer
item.description: All signs point to the next generation of console hardware being historically expensive. With rising component costs, the PS5 and Xbox Series are going for hundreds more than they did when they launched in 2020. In that context, it’s frightening to imagine the price of an even more powerful system, with one estimate placing potential manufacturing costs between $1,200 and $1,800 .

item.title: Pokémon’s Hyped Countdown Might Be Leading to a Letdown
item.description: In October and early November, The Pokémon Company started counting down toward the end of the month, as noted by Serebii webmaster Joe Merrick . Using Poké Ball-themed logos created for the franchise's 30th anniversary , Pokémon teased some sort of announcement for Nov. 30 at 14:00 UTC.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday Officially Skips Awards Screenings to Avoid Spoiler Leaks
item.description: Don't expect to see Avengers: Doomsday show up on the nomination lists at some of Hollywood's biggest awards shows in the coming months. That's because Disney and Marvel are taking extreme precautions to protect the intimate details of their upcoming superhero blockbuster , going so far as to withhold screeners in hopes of avoiding plot leaks. Still, this strategy won't dash all of Doomsday's award hopes.

item.title: Nintendo Switch Online Adds Another GameCube Classic
item.description: Nintendo Switch Online's expansive library of retro games is a treasure trove of nostalgic experiences, and it just got a little bit better. That's because the 2001 GameCube racing game Wave Race: Blue Storm has just been added to the Nintendo Switch Online Plus Expansion Pack library. With the chilly season fast approaching, it's the perfect excuse for a little tropical getaway from the comfort of your couch.

item.title: Canceled Mass Effect Addressed Squad Members’ Fates, Writer Reveals
item.description: Following the cancellation of the fifth mainline Mass Effect game, Mass Effect: Universe , fans can't help but wonder what could have been. In a recent Reddit AMA , Universe writer Cat Valente answered questions about the sequel, including how it would have addressed squad mates’ fates and Mass Effect 3 ’s controversial endings. Valente is an award-winning sci-fi and fantasy author and a Mass Effect series veteran, having previously written the 2018 novel Mass Effect: Annihilation . She worked on Universe for three years.

item.title: Fortnite Increases Treasure Spawn Rate and Odds, But There's a Catch
item.description: Fortnite Treasure Hunters ends on Dec. 5, which means all treasure, including the Pirate Shop Access token, which grants players up to four weeks of free Item Shop goodies , will be vaulted soon. With less than two weeks to go, a large portion of the community fears that they will not be able to get their hands on the Pirate Shop Access token at all.

item.title: We Played 'Magic: the Gathering’s Most Unhinged Set of All Time and It Was Pure Chaos
item.description: “My goal was that each card would be charming,” principal designer Gavin Verhey told Polygon at MagicCon. “You should see it and you’d be like, ‘That’s crazy. I’ve never seen that before.’ Or, ‘That’s so funny, made me smile.’”

item.title: GTA 6 Is Bigger Than Taylor Swift, Analysts Say
item.description: Taylor Swift is one of the biggest music artists in modern times. From 2023 to late 2024, the Eras Tour took her all over the world to play nearly 150 shows for millions of fans. It was a monumental moment in her career, and it earned $2 billion in ticket sales , becoming the highest-grossing tour of all time. Grand Theft Auto 6 grossed double that amount, in just four days.

item.title: Adam Driver and Steven Soderbergh Worked for Free on Their Star Wars Movie — Until Disney Killed It
item.description: One of the first rules I learned when I entered the job market was: never work for free. Adam Driver and Steven Soderbergh didn't care much about that rule, because they had been given such strong assurances that Disney would approve their Star Wars film, The Hunt for Ben Solo .
